findings.title: Production SSL Handshake Abrupt Termination
findings.description: During direct TLS probe to https://ecotechservices.tech, the server closed the connection abruptly without close_notify. This indicates an SSL chain or CDN forwarding issue on port 443.
findings.recommendation: Verify SSL certificate installation in Hostinger/Cloudflare panel and ensure Full (Strict) SSL encryption mode is active.

findings.title: Missing Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) Header
findings.description: The response does not send HSTS header, leaving users and search bots vulnerable to downgrade attacks.
findings.recommendation: Add 'Header always set Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload"' to .htaccess.
